# vinhnt-sdk — AI Agent SDK for TypeScript

> A modular, extensible SDK for building AI agents with TypeScript.
> 18 packages: 11 core + 7 extension.

## Getting Started
- [Installation](getting-started/installation.en.mdx)
- [Quickstart](getting-started/quickstart.en.mdx)
- [Authentication](getting-started/authentication.en.mdx)

## Architecture
- [System Overview](architecture/index.en.mdx)
- [Dependency Graph](architecture/dependency-graph.en.mdx)
- [Design Patterns](architecture/design-patterns.en.mdx)
- [Package Layers](architecture/package-layers.en.mdx)

## API Reference — Core Layer
- [@vinhnt-sdk/schema](api/schema.en.mdx) — Types, contracts, branded IDs, errors
- [@vinhnt-sdk/config](api/config.en.mdx) — Credentials, env resolution, settings
- [@vinhnt-sdk/llm](api/llm.en.mdx) — LLM adapter abstraction, registry, retry
- [@vinhnt-sdk/tools](api/tools.en.mdx) — Tool framework + built-in tools (fs, shell, git, web, search)
- [@vinhnt-sdk/sandbox](api/sandbox.en.mdx) — Process isolation, command parsing
- [@vinhnt-sdk/guard](api/guard.en.mdx) — Circuit breaker, loop detection, tool timeout
- [@vinhnt-sdk/session](api/session.en.mdx) — Session state, stores, compaction
- [@vinhnt-sdk/permission](api/permission.en.mdx) — Permission rules, approval stores
- [@vinhnt-sdk/step-executor](api/step-executor.en.mdx) — Execution kernel, self-correction
- [@vinhnt-sdk/core](api/core.en.mdx) — AgentKernel, plugin manager, orchestration
- [@vinhnt-sdk/provider-openai-compatible](api/provider-openai-compatible.en.mdx) — OpenAI-compatible provider + presets

## API Reference — Extension Layer
- [@vinhnt-sdk/plugin](api/plugin.en.mdx) — Plugin hooks, npm loader
- [@vinhnt-sdk/knowledge](api/knowledge.en.mdx) — Memory, context compression
- [@vinhnt-sdk/event](api/event.en.mdx) — Typed event bus, durable replay
- [@vinhnt-sdk/mcp](api/mcp.en.mdx) — MCP client, transports
- [@vinhnt-sdk/trace](api/trace.en.mdx) — Telemetry, timeline, cost tracking
- [@vinhnt-sdk/security](api/security.en.mdx) — Secret redactor, injection detection
- [@vinhnt-sdk/lsp](api/lsp.en.mdx) — LSP integration, diagnostics
